newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in Midopa, Dainong suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Midopa, Dainong suspended.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday it had suspended trading in shares of Midopa Department Store and Dainong Corp from early Monday afternoon on rumours that they would be bailed out by creditors.
Both Midopa and Dainong rose to their respective daily limits before trading was halted, brokers said. Midopa was up 600 won to 8,140 and Dainong up 230 won to 3,180.

A SEOULBANK spokesman said the two companies and two other unlisted firms of the Dainong group had been designated for bail-out, under an earlier agreement among major banks to prevent promising companies from collapsing.
Details are due to be announced later on Monday.
The Dainong Group has been troubled by heavy debts since earnings by its affiliates worsened in line with a cyclical downturn of the national economy.
